production_saving_claim.reason: No real versioned episode, independent sequence outcomes or paired provider measurements.

scope: Attach existing CapturedRun results to explicit memory episodes; no callable/transport accepted, no model or homelab execution launched.

contracts: Existing caller executes once; attachment/duplicate rejection never executes or retries.
Measured failure retains its error type and optional explicit partial usage.
Unknown verifier/usage retains null verdict and metrics.
Wrong task/route/request pin and changed output are rejected before recording.
Rejected or oversized usage preserves the existing execution.
Execution byte-budget rejection is a logging failure and preserves the caller result.
Execution/usage rows bind final sequence/archive and original turn hashes.
Fixture origin cannot upgrade to provider evidence; local latency never fills provider latency.
Raw request/output/exception message absent from execution sidecar.
Recorded output verification does not supply offline sequence labels.
